name: Atlas four-finger hand
summary: The October 2026 redesign of the electric Atlas hand: four fingers and 13 DoF (up from 7), with a 4-DoF opposable thumb and three 3-DoF fingers that can spread. It uses a single actuator type and no cables crossing joints, and is aimed at in-hand manipulation, tool use and AI data collection.
